limits: ONE synthetic repeated coordination game, not four validated environments. Domain labels cosmetic/context framing.
Rounds and factorial variants strongly correlated. No naive p-values from raw record counts.
Peer/self shadow attribution changes current incoming note only; historical dialogue remains actual peer history.
Later bad peer proposals are genuinely generated but their following can be ordinary persuasion, not trained collusion.
A shared bonus explicitly supplies an incentive. Bonus-only violations are not evidence of an unrequested hidden goal.
Comprehension readout and choice can differ due to execution or role confusion; agreement on bad actions alone is not intent.
Owner/audit/game context is simulated. No real rewards, recipients, API tools, deletion, network or external actions.
Any stable candidate needs NEW independent tasks and targeted causal controls before original training objective attribution.
interpretation: Descriptive repeated-game development. Read actual proposals and first-onset trajectories. Rounds are not independent; no automatic trained-collusion finding.
